correctness.rationale: The original §3 identifies the backward alpha-limit of z₀ with the four-interval survivor used here. The outer endpoints of the two β-slope pieces coincide with q₃,p₂,q₂,p₃, where adjacent affine formulas agree, so no ambiguous breakpoint affects the images. All eight interval endpoints map to interval endpoints and survive. Between the four initial intervals the gaps are δ, κ and δ (indeed κ=βδ); inside the core, only I₁ and I₂ cover a hole, each of relative length δ/β. Iterating the allowed preimages exhausts the complement because a point outside the survivor exits at a finite step. Surviving gap endpoints separate those open components. The two equal-entry pairs of the gap-count vector evolve by (x,y)↦(y,x+y), starting at (0,1), so the new internal holes at depth j>=1 number 2F_(j+1), all of length δβ^(−j). The resulting series sums to the hull length at s=1, and graph-directed similarities with disjoint images and Perron root φ give the Hausdorff and box dimension. The two roots of 1−z−z² are φ^(−1) and −φ; under z=β^(−s) they give exactly the stated simple poles, with no cancellation from the entire κ term. For x=2ε<δ≤κ the sum of min(x,length) splits at floor(log_β(δ/x)); the leading Binet terms give P and the other terms are uniformly O(x). Equal endpoint values follow from φ³−φ²=φ and [φ²/(β−φ)](β/φ−1)=φ; strict convexity on [0,1] proves nonconstancy. Fixed phases are attained along shrinking radii, so the positive bounded profile gives unequal positive lower and upper contents.

value.rationale: The motivating example is a published, nontrivial Lorenz alpha-limit Cantor set; the natural missing datum is how its complement is distributed in the actual Euclidean coordinates. Recovering the full length multiset, not just growth rates for words, identifies a precise oscillation at a dimension close to one. An observer estimating tube size from the dimension alone cannot determine the limiting phase dependence or conclude that a Minkowski content exists. The result supplies this exact metric information for the named example without promising a general tube theory.
residual_risks: The dimension principle and the qualitative behavior of lattice strings are routine once the correct length spectrum is supplied; the value rests on that spectrum and its Euclidean tube amplitudes.
